episodes.title: On Mind Control and Freedom: with Steven Hassan
episodes.description:
He was the smartest kid in the room — and it still didn't save him.

At nineteen, Steve Hassan was an honors student with his whole life ahead of him. Weeks later, he was a devoted follower of a self-declared messiah, sleep-deprived, isolated from his family, and convinced his old self was "evil." He didn't get out because he was strong. He got out because of a near-fatal car crash — and the chance to finally sleep.

Fifty years later, Dr. Hassan is one of the world's leading experts on cults and mind control, the author of Combating Cult Mind Control, Freedom of Mind, and the bestselling The Cult of Trump. In this conversation, he breaks down:

🧠 The BITE model — how authoritarian control actually works, step by step
🔴 The decades-old Trump–Russia connection few people know about
⛪ How fringe religious movements got rebranded as mainstream politics
📱 Why algorithms are now running the same playbook cults have used for decades
❤️ The one thing that protects people from manipulation — and it's not intelligence

If you've ever wondered how ordinary, intelligent people end up trapped in extremist beliefs — or how to reach a loved one who has — this is the conversation to watch.
